nombre: Kubo narra: La guerra de los emús (EN)

voz.texto: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia declared war... on birds. And lost.
Twenty thousand emus invaded the wheat farms of Western Australia.
They ate the crops, broke the fences... and let the rabbits in.
So the farmers, many of them ex-soldiers, asked for machine guns.
The army sent Major Meredith, two machine guns... and ten thousand bullets.
Wrong. The emus split into tiny groups, and ran in every direction.
Each group had a lookout: a tall black bird that watched the soldiers, and warned the others.
After six days, the army retreated.
They came back. After a month, Meredith reported nine hundred and eighty-six birds...
using nine thousand, eight hundred and sixty bullets. Exactly ten bullets per emu.
His verdict? They can face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
The emus won. The army went home.
Send this to the friend who always says: it can't be that hard.
